title: VTA PCS — Voter Receipt — payload
description: A voter's client hands its VTA the ballot box's receipt for a cast, and optionally a checkpoint and an inclusion proof; the VTA checks the receipt is the voter's, keeps it, and says whether the cast is in the checkpoint.

contextId.description: The context the voter belongs to.

receipt.description: The ballot box's signed voting/ballot/cast/0.1 #response document, whole and exactly as received.

checkpoint.description: A signed voting/board/head/0.1 #response document, whole and exactly as received — typically the head the community kept at close (vtc/elections/show checkpoints).

Inclusion.title: Inclusion
Inclusion.description: The members of a voting/board/inclusion/0.1 response that prove one entry is in a head: RFC 9162 §2.1.3 audit path for `leafIndex` in a tree of `treeSize`.

entryHash.description: The RFC 9162 leaf hash of the entry at `leafIndex`, as a multihash.

Response.title: VTA PCS — Voter Receipt — response payload

status.description: `kept`: the receipt is the voter's and is kept; no checkpoint was given. `included`: the cast is in the checkpoint. `notIncluded`: the checkpoint is a valid head of the election and the evidence does not show the cast in it — the client MUST show this to the voter (VTI-VOT-053).

leafIndex.description: The board position the receipt assigns to the cast.
